Now, let's create our main app files. I'll start with the App.js file which will set up our navigation and theme:





---

```diff
- 
+ import React from 'react';
+ import { NavigationContainer } from '@react-navigation/native';
+ import { createBottomTabNavigator } from '@react-navigation/bottom-tabs';
+ import { Provider as PaperProvider } from 'react-native-paper';
+ import { SafeAreaProvider } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
+ import { MaterialCommunityIcons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
+ 
+ // Import screens (we'll create these next)
+ import HomeScreen from './src/screens/HomeScreen';
+ import HistoryScreen from './src/screens/HistoryScreen';
+ 
+ // Define our theme colors based on the design document
+ const theme = {
+   colors: {
+     primary: '#A67B5B', // Warm puppy brown
+     secondary: '#7BCDEE', // Playful light blue
+     accent: '#FF9E44', // Energetic orange
+     background: '#FFF8E8', // Soft cream
+     text: '#4A3728', // Dark brown
+   },
+ };
+ 
+ const Tab = createBottomTabNavigator();
+ 
+ export default function App() {
+   return (
+     <SafeAreaProvider>
+       <PaperProvider theme={theme}>
+         <NavigationContainer>
+           <Tab.Navigator
+             screenOptions={({ route }) => ({
+               tabBarIcon: ({ focused, color, size }) => {
+                 let iconName;
+ 
+                 if (route.name === 'Home') {
+                   iconName = focused ? 'home' : 'home-outline';
+                 } else if (route.name === 'History') {
+                   iconName = focused ? 'history' : 'history';
+                 }
+ 
+                 return <MaterialCommunityIcons name={iconName} size={size} color={color} />;
+               },
+               tabBarActiveTintColor: theme.colors.primary,
+               tabBarInactiveTintColor: 'gray',
+               headerStyle: {
+                 backgroundColor: theme.colors.background,
+               },
+               headerTintColor: theme.colors.text,
+             })}
+           >
+             <Tab.Screen 
+               name="Home" 
+               component={HomeScreen}
+               options={{
+                 title: "Poppy's Food Tracker",
+               }}
+             />
+             <Tab.Screen 
+               name="History" 
+               component={HistoryScreen}
+               options={{
+                 title: 'Feeding History',
+               }}
+             />
+           </Tab.Navigator>
+         </NavigationContainer>
+       </PaperProvider>
+     </SafeAreaProvider>
+   );
+ } 
```

---

Now let's create the HomeScreen component. This will be our main screen for tracking daily feeding:




---

```diff
- 
+ import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
+ import { View, StyleSheet } from 'react-native';
+ import { Text, Button, Card } from 'react-native-paper';
+ import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
+ import { MaterialCommunityIcons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
+ 
+ const HomeScreen = () => {
+   const [amountFed, setAmountFed] = useState(0);
+   const [targetAmount, setTargetAmount] = useState(3); // Default target of 3 cups
+ 
+   // Load today's data when component mounts
+   useEffect(() => {
+     loadTodayData();
+   }, []);
+ 
+   const loadTodayData = async () => {
+     try {
+       const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
+       const jsonValue = await AsyncStorage.getItem('@PoppyTracker:currentDay');
+       let data = jsonValue != null ? JSON.parse(jsonValue) : null;
+ 
+       if (!data || data.date !== today) {
+         data = {
+           date: today,
+           amountFed: 0,
+           target: targetAmount,
+           timestamp: Date.now(),
+         };
+         await AsyncStorage.setItem('@PoppyTracker:currentDay', JSON.stringify(data));
+       }
+ 
+       setAmountFed(data.amountFed);
+       setTargetAmount(data.target);
+     } catch (e) {
+       console.error('Error loading data:', e);
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const saveFeedingData = async (newAmount) => {
+     try {
+       const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
+       const data = {
+         date: today,
+         amountFed: newAmount,
+         target: targetAmount,
+         timestamp: Date.now(),
+       };
+ 
+       await AsyncStorage.setItem('@PoppyTracker:currentDay', JSON.stringify(data));
+       
+       // Also update history
+       const history = await AsyncStorage.getItem('@PoppyTracker:feedingHistory');
+       const historyArray = history ? JSON.parse(history) : [];
+       
+       const todayIndex = historyArray.findIndex(item => item.date === today);
+       if (todayIndex >= 0) {
+         historyArray[todayIndex] = data;
+       } else {
+         historyArray.push(data);
+       }
+       
+       await AsyncStorage.setItem('@PoppyTracker:feedingHistory', JSON.stringify(historyArray));
+     } catch (e) {
+       console.error('Error saving data:', e);
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const adjustAmount = (change) => {
+     const newAmount = Math.max(0, amountFed + change);
+     setAmountFed(newAmount);
+     saveFeedingData(newAmount);
+   };
+ 
+   const renderCupIcons = () => {
+     const cups = [];
+     const totalCups = Math.ceil(targetAmount);
+ 
+     for (let i = 0; i < totalCups; i++) {
+       let fillPercentage = 0;
+       if (amountFed > i) {
+         fillPercentage = amountFed >= i + 1 ? 100 : (amountFed - i) * 100;
+       }
+ 
+       cups.push(
+         <View key={i} style={styles.cupContainer}>
+           <MaterialCommunityIcons
+             name="cup"
+             size={40}
+             color={fillPercentage === 100 ? theme.colors.primary : theme.colors.text}
+             style={[
+               styles.cupIcon,
+               { opacity: fillPercentage === 100 ? 1 : 0.3 }
+             ]}
+           />
+         </View>
+       );
+     }
+ 
+     return cups;
+   };
+ 
+   return (
+     <View style={styles.container}>
+       <Card style={styles.card}>
+         <Card.Content>
+           <Text style={styles.title}>Today's Feeding</Text>
+           
+           <View style={styles.progressContainer}>
+             {renderCupIcons()}
+           </View>
+ 
+           <View style={styles.amountContainer}>
+             <Text style={styles.amountText}>{amountFed.toFixed(2)} cups</Text>
+             <Text style={styles.targetText}>of {targetAmount} cups target</Text>
+           </View>
+ 
+           <View style={styles.buttonContainer}>
+             <Button
+               mode="contained"
+               onPress={() => adjustAmount(-0.25)}
+               style={[styles.button, styles.minusButton]}
+               icon="minus"
+             >
+               Remove ¼ Cup
+             </Button>
+             <Button
+               mode="contained"
+               onPress={() => adjustAmount(0.25)}
+               style={[styles.button, styles.plusButton]}
+               icon="plus"
+             >
+               Add ¼ Cup
+             </Button>
+           </View>
+         </Card.Content>
+       </Card>
+     </View>
+   );
+ };
+ 
+ const styles = StyleSheet.create({
+   container: {
+     flex: 1,
+     padding: 16,
+     backgroundColor: '#FFF8E8',
+   },
+   card: {
+     marginTop: 16,
+     backgroundColor: 'white',
+     borderRadius: 12,
+   },
+   title: {
+     fontSize: 24,
+     fontWeight: 'bold',
+     color: '#4A3728',
+     textAlign: 'center',
+     marginBottom: 16,
+   },
+   progressContainer: {
+     flexDirection: 'row',
+     justifyContent: 'center',
+     marginVertical: 16,
+   },
+   cupContainer: {
+     marginHorizontal: 4,
+   },
+   cupIcon: {
+     opacity: 0.3,
+   },
+   amountContainer: {
+     alignItems: 'center',
+     marginVertical: 16,
+   },
+   amountText: {
+     fontSize: 32,
+     fontWeight: 'bold',
+     color: '#A67B5B',
+   },
+   targetText: {
+     fontSize: 16,
+     color: '#4A3728',
+     marginTop: 4,
+   },
+   buttonContainer: {
+     flexDirection: 'row',
+     justifyContent: 'space-around',
+     marginTop: 16,
+   },
+   button: {
+     flex: 1,
+     marginHorizontal: 8,
+   },
+   minusButton: {
+     backgroundColor: '#FF9E44',
+   },
+   plusButton: {
+     backgroundColor: '#A67B5B',
+   },
+ });
+ 
+ export default HomeScreen; 
```

---

Now let's create the HistoryScreen component to display past feeding records:



---

```diff
- 
+ import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
+ import { View, StyleSheet, ScrollView } from 'react-native';
+ import { Text, Card, List } from 'react-native-paper';
+ import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
+ import { MaterialCommunityIcons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
+ 
+ const HistoryScreen = () => {
+   const [feedingHistory, setFeedingHistory] = useState([]);
+ 
+   useEffect(() => {
+     loadHistory();
+   }, []);
+ 
+   const loadHistory = async () => {
+     try {
+       const history = await AsyncStorage.getItem('@PoppyTracker:feedingHistory');
+       if (history) {
+         const parsedHistory = JSON.parse(history);
+         // Sort by date in descending order
+         const sortedHistory = parsedHistory.sort((a, b) => 
+           new Date(b.date) - new Date(a.date)
+         );
+         setFeedingHistory(sortedHistory);
+       }
+     } catch (e) {
+       console.error('Error loading history:', e);
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const formatDate = (dateString) => {
+     const date = new Date(dateString);
+     return date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
+       weekday: 'short',
+       month: 'short',
+       day: 'numeric',
+     });
+   };
+ 
+   const renderCupIcons = (amount, target) => {
+     const cups = [];
+     const totalCups = Math.ceil(target);
+ 
+     for (let i = 0; i < totalCups; i++) {
+       let fillPercentage = 0;
+       if (amount > i) {
+         fillPercentage = amount >= i + 1 ? 100 : (amount - i) * 100;
+       }
+ 
+       cups.push(
+         <MaterialCommunityIcons
+           key={i}
+           name="cup"
+           size={20}
+           color={fillPercentage === 100 ? '#A67B5B' : '#4A3728'}
+           style={[
+             styles.historyCupIcon,
+             { opacity: fillPercentage === 100 ? 1 : 0.3 }
+           ]}
+         />
+       );
+     }
+ 
+     return cups;
+   };
+ 
+   return (
+     <View style={styles.container}>
+       <Card style={styles.summaryCard}>
+         <Card.Content>
+           <Text style={styles.summaryTitle}>Weekly Summary</Text>
+           <View style={styles.summaryContent}>
+             <Text style={styles.summaryText}>
+               Average Daily Feeding: {
+                 feedingHistory.length > 0
+                   ? (feedingHistory.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + entry.amountFed, 0) / 
+                      feedingHistory.length).toFixed(2)
+                   : '0.00'
+               } cups
+             </Text>
+           </View>
+         </Card.Content>
+       </Card>
+ 
+       <ScrollView style={styles.historyContainer}>
+         {feedingHistory.map((entry, index) => (
+           <Card key={index} style={styles.historyCard}>
+             <Card.Content>
+               <View style={styles.historyHeader}>
+                 <Text style={styles.historyDate}>{formatDate(entry.date)}</Text>
+                 <Text style={styles.historyAmount}>
+                   {entry.amountFed.toFixed(2)} cups
+                 </Text>
+               </View>
+               <View style={styles.cupIconsContainer}>
+                 {renderCupIcons(entry.amountFed, entry.target)}
+               </View>
+             </Card.Content>
+           </Card>
+         ))}
+       </ScrollView>
+     </View>
+   );
+ };
+ 
+ const styles = StyleSheet.create({
+   container: {
+     flex: 1,
+     padding: 16,
+     backgroundColor: '#FFF8E8',
+   },
+   summaryCard: {
+     marginBottom: 16,
+     backgroundColor: 'white',
+     borderRadius: 12,
+   },
+   summaryTitle: {
+     fontSize: 20,
+     fontWeight: 'bold',
+     color: '#4A3728',
+     marginBottom: 8,
+   },
+   summaryContent: {
+     alignItems: 'center',
+   },
+   summaryText: {
+     fontSize: 16,
+     color: '#4A3728',
+   },
+   historyContainer: {
+     flex: 1,
+   },
+   historyCard: {
+     marginBottom: 8,
+     backgroundColor: 'white',
+     borderRadius: 12,
+   },
+   historyHeader: {
+     flexDirection: 'row',
+     justifyContent: 'space-between',
+     alignItems: 'center',
+     marginBottom: 8,
+   },
+   historyDate: {
+     fontSize: 16,
+     fontWeight: 'bold',
+     color: '#4A3728',
+   },
+   historyAmount: {
+     fontSize: 16,
+     color: '#A67B5B',
+   },
+   cupIconsContainer: {
+     flexDirection: 'row',
+     flexWrap: 'wrap',
+   },
+   historyCupIcon: {
+     marginRight: 4,
+   },
+ });
+ 
+ export default HistoryScreen;
```

Let's create a storage utility file to handle all AsyncStorage operations:





---

```diff
- 
+ import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
+ 
+ const STORAGE_KEYS = {
+   CURRENT_DAY: '@PoppyTracker:currentDay',
+   FEEDING_HISTORY: '@PoppyTracker:feedingHistory',
+   SETTINGS: '@PoppyTracker:settings',
+ };
+ 
+ export const storage = {
+   // Save today's feeding data
+   saveTodayData: async (data) => {
+     try {
+       await AsyncStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.CURRENT_DAY, JSON.stringify(data));
+       return true;
+     } catch (e) {
+       console.error('Error saving today\'s data:', e);
+       return false;
+     }
+   },
+ 
+   // Load today's feeding data
+   loadTodayData: async () => {
+     try {
+       const jsonValue = await AsyncStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.CURRENT_DAY);
+       return jsonValue != null ? JSON.parse(jsonValue) : null;
+     } catch (e) {
+       console.error('Error loading today\'s data:', e);
+       return null;
+     }
+   },
+ 
+   // Save feeding history
+   saveFeedingHistory: async (history) => {
+     try {
+       await AsyncStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.FEEDING_HISTORY, JSON.stringify(history));
+       return true;
+     } catch (e) {
+       console.error('Error saving feeding history:', e);
+       return false;
+     }
+   },
+ 
+   // Load feeding history
+   loadFeedingHistory: async () => {
+     try {
+       const jsonValue = await AsyncStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.FEEDING_HISTORY);
+       return jsonValue != null ? JSON.parse(jsonValue) : [];
+     } catch (e) {
+       console.error('Error loading feeding history:', e);
+       return [];
+     }
+   },
+ 
+   // Save app settings
+   saveSettings: async (settings) => {
+     try {
+       await AsyncStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.SETTINGS, JSON.stringify(settings));
+       return true;
+     } catch (e) {
+       console.error('Error saving settings:', e);
+       return false;
+     }
+   },
+ 
+   // Load app settings
+   loadSettings: async () => {
+     try {
+       const jsonValue = await AsyncStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.SETTINGS);
+       return jsonValue != null ? JSON.parse(jsonValue) : { target: 3 };
+     } catch (e) {
+       console.error('Error loading settings:', e);
+       return { target: 3 };
+     }
+   },
+ 
+   // Clear all data (for testing/reset)
+   clearAllData: async () => {
+     try {
+       await AsyncStorage.clear();
+       return true;
+     } catch (e) {
+       console.error('Error clearing data:', e);
+       return false;
+     }
+   },
+ };
+ 
+ export default storage; 
```

Great! I've now created all the necessary files for the Poppy's Food Tracker app. Here's a summary of what we've built:

1. **App Structure**:
   - `App.js`: Main app component with navigation and theme setup
   - `src/screens/HomeScreen.js`: Main screen for tracking daily feeding
   - `src/screens/HistoryScreen.js`: Screen for viewing feeding history
   - `src/utils/theme.js`: Centralized theme configuration
   - `src/utils/storage.js`: Storage utility for handling AsyncStorage operations

2. **Features Implemented**:
   - Daily feeding tracker with cup visualization
   - Add/remove food in 0.25 cup increments
   - Feeding history with date formatting
   - Weekly average calculation
   - Local storage persistence
   - Theme-consistent UI with Poppy's color scheme

3. **To run the app**:
   1. Make sure you're in the `app` directory
   2. Run `npm install` to install dependencies
   3. Run `npx expo start` to start the development server
   4. Use the Expo Go app on your iOS device to scan the QR code and run the app

The app follows the design document specifications with:
- A cute, user-friendly interface
- Visual progress indicators with cup icons
- Easy-to-use controls for adjusting food amounts
- Persistent storage of feeding data
- Clean, organized code structure

```diff
  
  Poppy's Food Tracker is a React Native mobile application built with Expo for iOS that helps track how much dog food has been given to Poppy each day. The app features a simple, cute interface with a Poppy theme and stores feeding history in device storage.
+ 
+ ## Implementation Status
+ 
+ ### Completed Features ✅
+ 1. Project setup with Expo and required dependencies
+ 2. Navigation structure with Home and History tabs
+ 3. Theme system implementation
+ 4. Local storage system with AsyncStorage
+ 5. Home Screen with:
+    - Daily feeding tracker
+    - Visual cup progress indicators
+    - Add/Remove food controls
+    - Automatic data persistence
+ 6. History Screen with:
+    - Feeding history list
+    - Weekly average calculation
+    - Visual cup indicators for past entries
+ 
+ ### Pending Features ⏳
+ 1. Calendar view for date selection
+ 2. Date range filtering
+ 3. Monthly statistics
+ 4. API integration
+ 5. Additional visual elements (paw prints, dog illustration)
+ 6. Settings screen for target amount adjustment
  
  ## Core Features
  
- 1. **Daily Feeding Tracker**: Record and adjust the amount of food (in cups) given to Poppy
- 2. **Visual Progress Indicator**: Cup icons showing feeding progress
- 3. **History View**: Access past feeding records
- 4. **Local Storage**: Store feeding data on the device
```

```diff
+ import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
+ import { View, StyleSheet } from 'react-native';
+ import { Text, Button, Card } from 'react-native-paper';
+ import { MaterialCommunityIcons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
+ import storage from '../../src/utils/storage';
+ import theme from '../../src/utils/theme';
+ 
+ export default function HomeScreen() {
+   const [amountFed, setAmountFed] = useState(0);
+   const [targetAmount, setTargetAmount] = useState(3);
+ 
+   useEffect(() => {
+     loadTodayData();
+   }, []);
+ 
+   const loadTodayData = async () => {
+     const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
+     const data = await storage.loadTodayData();
+     const settings = await storage.loadSettings();
+ 
+     if (!data || data.date !== today) {
+       const newData = {
+         date: today,
+         amountFed: 0,
+         target: settings.target,
+         timestamp: Date.now(),
+       };
+       await storage.saveTodayData(newData);
+       setAmountFed(0);
+       setTargetAmount(settings.target);
+     } else {
+       setAmountFed(data.amountFed);
+       setTargetAmount(data.target);
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const saveFeedingData = async (newAmount) => {
+     const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
+     const data = {
+       date: today,
+       amountFed: newAmount,
+       target: targetAmount,
+       timestamp: Date.now(),
+     };
+ 
+     await storage.saveTodayData(data);
+     
+     // Update history
+     const history = await storage.loadFeedingHistory();
+     const todayIndex = history.findIndex(item => item.date === today);
+     
+     if (todayIndex >= 0) {
+       history[todayIndex] = data;
+     } else {
+       history.push(data);
+     }
+     
+     await storage.saveFeedingHistory(history);
+   };
+ 
+   const adjustAmount = (change) => {
+     const newAmount = Math.max(0, amountFed + change);
+     setAmountFed(newAmount);
+     saveFeedingData(newAmount);
+   };
+ 
+   const renderCupIcons = () => {
+     const cups = [];
+     const totalCups = Math.ceil(targetAmount);
+ 
+     for (let i = 0; i < totalCups; i++) {
+       let fillPercentage = 0;
+       if (amountFed > i) {
+         fillPercentage = amountFed >= i + 1 ? 100 : (amountFed - i) * 100;
+       }
+ 
+       cups.push(
+         <View key={i} style={styles.cupContainer}>
+           <MaterialCommunityIcons
+             name="cup"
+             size={40}
+             color={fillPercentage === 100 ? theme.colors.primary : theme.colors.text}
+             style={[
+               styles.cupIcon,
+               { opacity: fillPercentage === 100 ? 1 : 0.3 }
+             ]}
+           />
+         </View>
+       );
+     }
+ 
+     return cups;
+   };
+ 
+   return (
+     <View style={styles.container}>
+       <Card style={styles.card}>
+         <Card.Content>
+           <Text style={styles.title}>Today's Feeding</Text>
+           
+           <View style={styles.progressContainer}>
+             {renderCupIcons()}
+           </View>
+ 
+           <View style={styles.amountContainer}>
+             <Text style={styles.amountText}>{amountFed.toFixed(2)} cups</Text>
+             <Text style={styles.targetText}>of {targetAmount} cups target</Text>
+           </View>
+ 
+           <View style={styles.buttonContainer}>
+             <Button
+               mode="contained"
+               onPress={() => adjustAmount(-0.25)}
+               style={[styles.button, styles.minusButton]}
+               icon="minus"
+             >
+               Remove ¼ Cup
+             </Button>
+             <Button
+               mode="contained"
+               onPress={() => adjustAmount(0.25)}
+               style={[styles.button, styles.plusButton]}
+               icon="plus"
+             >
+               Add ¼ Cup
+             </Button>
+           </View>
+         </Card.Content>
+       </Card>
+     </View>
+   );
+ }
+ 
+ const styles = StyleSheet.create({
+   container: {
+     flex: 1,
+     padding: theme.spacing.md,
+     backgroundColor: theme.colors.background,
+   },
+   card: {
+     marginTop: theme.spacing.md,
+     backgroundColor: theme.colors.white,
+     borderRadius: theme.borderRadius.medium,
+   },
+   title: {
+     ...theme.typography.title,
+     color: theme.colors.text,
+     textAlign: 'center',
+     marginBottom: theme.spacing.md,
+   },
+   progressContainer: {
+     flexDirection: 'row',
+     justifyContent: 'center',
+     marginVertical: theme.spacing.md,
+   },
+   cupContainer: {
+     marginHorizontal: theme.spacing.xs,
+   },
+   cupIcon: {
+     opacity: 0.3,
+   },
+   amountContainer: {
+     alignItems: 'center',
+     marginVertical: theme.spacing.md,
+   },
+   amountText: {
+     fontSize: 32,
+     fontWeight: 'bold',
+     color: theme.colors.primary,
+   },
+   targetText: {
+     ...theme.typography.body,
+     color: theme.colors.text,
+     marginTop: theme.spacing.xs,
+   },
+   buttonContainer: {
+     flexDirection: 'row',
+     justifyContent: 'space-around',
+     marginTop: theme.spacing.md,
+   },
+   button: {
+     flex: 1,
+     marginHorizontal: theme.spacing.sm,
+   },
+   minusButton: {
+     backgroundColor: theme.colors.accent,
+   },
+   plusButton: {
+     backgroundColor: theme.colors.primary,
+   },
+ });
```

```diff
+ import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
+ import { View, StyleSheet, ScrollView } from 'react-native';
+ import { Text, Card, Divider } from 'react-native-paper';
+ import { MaterialCommunityIcons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
+ import storage from '../../src/utils/storage';
+ import theme from '../../src/utils/theme';
+ 
+ export default function HistoryScreen() {
+   const [history, setHistory] = useState([]);
+   const [weeklyAverage, setWeeklyAverage] = useState(0);
+ 
+   useEffect(() => {
+     loadHistory();
+   }, []);
+ 
+   const loadHistory = async () => {
+     const data = await storage.loadFeedingHistory();
+     const sortedHistory = data.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.date) - new Date(a.date));
+     setHistory(sortedHistory);
+ 
+     // Calculate weekly average
+     const last7Days = sortedHistory.slice(0, 7);
+     const total = last7Days.reduce((sum, day) => sum + day.amountFed, 0);
+     setWeeklyAverage(last7Days.length > 0 ? total / last7Days.length : 0);
+   };
+ 
+   const formatDate = (dateString) => {
+     const date = new Date(dateString);
+     return date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
+       weekday: 'short',
+       month: 'short',
+       day: 'numeric',
+     });
+   };
+ 
+   const renderCupIcons = (amount, target) => {
+     const cups = [];
+     const totalCups = Math.ceil(target);
+ 
+     for (let i = 0; i < totalCups; i++) {
+       let fillPercentage = 0;
+       if (amount > i) {
+         fillPercentage = amount >= i + 1 ? 100 : (amount - i) * 100;
+       }
+ 
+       cups.push(
+         <MaterialCommunityIcons
+           key={i}
+           name="cup"
+           size={20}
+           color={fillPercentage === 100 ? theme.colors.primary : theme.colors.text}
+           style={[
+             styles.cupIcon,
+             { opacity: fillPercentage === 100 ? 1 : 0.3 }
+           ]}
+         />
+       );
+     }
+ 
+     return cups;
+   };
+ 
+   return (
+     <View style={styles.container}>
+       <Card style={styles.summaryCard}>
+         <Card.Content>
+           <Text style={styles.summaryTitle}>Weekly Average</Text>
+           <Text style={styles.summaryAmount}>{weeklyAverage.toFixed(2)} cups</Text>
+           <Text style={styles.summarySubtitle}>Last 7 days</Text>
+         </Card.Content>
+       </Card>
+ 
+       <ScrollView style={styles.historyContainer}>
+         {history.map((item, index) => (
+           <React.Fragment key={item.date}>
+             <Card style={styles.historyCard}>
+               <Card.Content>
+                 <View style={styles.historyHeader}>
+                   <Text style={styles.historyDate}>{formatDate(item.date)}</Text>
+                   <Text style={styles.historyAmount}>{item.amountFed.toFixed(2)} cups</Text>
+                 </View>
+                 <View style={styles.cupContainer}>
+                   {renderCupIcons(item.amountFed, item.target)}
+                 </View>
+                 <Text style={styles.historyTarget}>Target: {item.target} cups</Text>
+               </Card.Content>
+             </Card>
+             {index < history.length - 1 && <Divider style={styles.divider} />}
+           </React.Fragment>
+         ))}
+       </ScrollView>
+     </View>
+   );
+ }
+ 
+ const styles = StyleSheet.create({
+   container: {
+     flex: 1,
+     backgroundColor: theme.colors.background,
+   },
+   summaryCard: {
+     margin: theme.spacing.md,
+     backgroundColor: theme.colors.white,
+     borderRadius: theme.borderRadius.medium,
+   },
+   summaryTitle: {
+     ...theme.typography.title,
+     color: theme.colors.text,
+     textAlign: 'center',
+   },
+   summaryAmount: {
+     fontSize: 32,
+     fontWeight: 'bold',
+     color: theme.colors.primary,
+     textAlign: 'center',
+     marginVertical: theme.spacing.sm,
+   },
+   summarySubtitle: {
+     ...theme.typography.body,
+     color: theme.colors.text,
+     textAlign: 'center',
+   },
+   historyContainer: {
+     flex: 1,
+     padding: theme.spacing.md,
+   },
+   historyCard: {
+     backgroundColor: theme.colors.white,
+     borderRadius: theme.borderRadius.medium,
+     marginBottom: theme.spacing.sm,
+   },
+   historyHeader: {
+     flexDirection: 'row',
+     justifyContent: 'space-between',
+     alignItems: 'center',
+     marginBottom: theme.spacing.sm,
+   },
+   historyDate: {
+     ...theme.typography.subtitle,
+     color: theme.colors.text,
+   },
+   historyAmount: {
+     ...theme.typography.subtitle,
+     color: theme.colors.primary,
+     fontWeight: 'bold',
+   },
+   cupContainer: {
+     flexDirection: 'row',
+     marginVertical: theme.spacing.sm,
+   },
+   cupIcon: {

+   historyTarget: {
+     ...theme.typography.body,
+     color: theme.colors.text,
+   },
+   divider: {
+     marginVertical: theme.spacing.sm,
+   },
+ });
```

   - The target amount for that day

The component uses the same styling and theme system as the HomeScreen, maintaining consistency across the app. It also uses the same storage utilities to load and display the feeding history data.

The history items are sorted by date (newest first) and the weekly average is calculated from the last 7 days of data. The cup icons are rendered with the same visual style as the HomeScreen, providing a consistent user experience.
